subject: physics
text: A tightly wound 100 turns coil of radius 10 cm carries a current of 7 A. The magnitude of the magnetic field at the centre of the coil is (Take permeability of free space as 4π×10⁻⁷ SI units):
explanation: Magnetic field at the centre of a coil B = (μ₀NI) / 2r = (4π×10⁻⁷ × 100 × 7) / (2 × 0.1) = 4.4 × 10⁻³ T = 4.4 mT.

subject: physics
text: A thermodynamic system is taken through the cycle abcda. The work done by the gas along the path bc is:
explanation: As volume is constant along path bc (isochoric process), the work done W = ∫P dV = 0.

subject: physics
text: An unipolar light beam strikes a glass surface at Brewster’s angle. Then:
options: both the reflected and refracted light will be completely polarised.
the reflected light will be completely polarised but the refracted light will be partially polarised.
the reflected light will be partially polarised.
the refracted light will be completely polarised.
explanation: At Brewster's angle, the reflected light is completely polarised perpendicular to the plane of incidence, but the refracted light is only partially polarised.

subject: physics
text: In an ideal transformer, the turns ratio is Np/Ns = 1/2. The ratio Vs : Vp is equal to (the symbols carry their usual meaning):
explanation: For an ideal transformer, Vs/Vp = Ns/Np. Since Np/Ns = 1/2, Ns/Np = 2/1. Thus Vs:Vp = 2:1.

subject: physics
text:
A logic circuit provides the output Y as per the following truth table:
A B Y
0 0 1
0 1 0
1 0 1
1 1 0
explanation: Looking at the truth table, Y is exactly the inverse of B. When B is 0, Y is 1. When B is 1, Y is 0. Hence Y = B̅.

subject: physics
text: In a vernier calipers, (N + 1) divisions of vernier scale coincide with N divisions of main scale. If 1 MSD represents 0.1 mm, the vernier constant (in cm) is:
explanation: 1 VSD = N / (N + 1) MSD. Least count = 1 MSD - 1 VSD = 1 MSD (1 - N / (N + 1)) = MSD / (N + 1). Given 1 MSD = 0.1 mm = 0.01 cm = 1/100 cm. So LC = 1 / 100(N + 1) cm.

subject: physics
text: The maximum elongation of a steel wire of 1 m length if the elastic limit of steel and its Young’s modulus, respectively, are 8 × 10⁸ N m⁻² and 2 × 10¹¹ N m⁻², is:
explanation: Maximum strain = Elastic limit / Young's modulus = (8 × 10⁸) / (2 × 10¹¹) = 4 × 10⁻³. Maximum elongation Δl = Strain × Length = 4 × 10⁻³ × 1 m = 4 mm.

subject: physics
text: A horizontal force 10 N is applied to a block A as shown in figure. The mass of blocks A and B are 2 kg and 3 kg, respectively. The blocks slide over a frictionless surface. The force exerted by block A on block B is:
explanation: Common acceleration a = F_net / M_total = 10 / (2 + 3) = 2 m/s². The force exerted by A on B is the mass of B times acceleration: F_AB = m_B × a = 3 kg × 2 m/s² = 6 N.

subject: physics
text: If the monochromatic source in Young’s double slit experiment is replaced by white light, then
options: there will be a central bright white fringe surrounded by a few coloured fringes.
all bright fringes will be of equal width.
there will be a central dark fringe surrounded by a few coloured fringes.
explanation: When white light is used, the central fringe is formed by the overlapping of all colours (path difference = 0), making it white. Surrounding it are a few coloured fringes before they blur into white due to extensive overlapping.
